title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1973-04-02

ai_review.summary: A lovely early‑'73 show highlighted by a rare China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider jam and tight transitions, captured from an unknown source with no reported audio issues.
ai_review.review: Reviewers praise the performance – especially the spontaneous “Mind Left Body Jam” that bridges China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider, the extended space‑noodle on Here Comes Sunshine, and the seamless segues from Weather Report Suite into Eyes of the World.  The recording itself isn’t described in detail, but no technical flaws are noted, making it a pleasant listening experience for fans who enjoy fast‑paced, well‑crafted ’73 shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and highlight strong musical moments; lack of recording comments suggests at least adequate sound, leading to an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No reviewer mentions soundboard or audience issues; audio quality is assumed acceptable but not specifically praised.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider (with "Mind Left Body Jam")
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions noted, especially the segway from Weather Report Suite into Eyes and the closing harmonies on the tour‑ending number.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s send‑off at the close is praised; his guitar work blends well in the jam sections.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass line contributes to the splendid chord transition highlighted by reviewers.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob’s rhythm playing is noted as part of the seamless chord transition during the special interim piece.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboard work helps shape the “Mind Left Body Jam” and overall harmonic flow.
